tasks.short: Cue or signal animals during performances.

steps.what: Check the animal, surroundings and performance cue plan
Give cues and adapt timing to the animals actual responses during performance
Write the actual cue outcome and welfare or follow-up observations
Check and approve the final performance note and animal reference
Save the approved performance observation note

tasks.design: Keep live cueing and response judgement human. Separate the post-performance observation note, final check and save in {OPS_SYSTEM}. Examine the current native note form and save route; this design assumes it already writes directly to the animal record, so no additional transfer is removed. A template does not remove the trainers need to observe and describe actual responses.
tasks.previous_blocker: Cue timing depends on the animal and surroundings in the moment.
tasks.enabler_now: The existing direct animal-record form already handles the limited documentation route.
tasks.still_hard: Welfare, timing and safe response require continuous trainer attention.
tasks.human_edge: Change or stop a cue when the animal is not responding comfortably.
tasks.altitude: Unchanged live performance work with explicit documentation steps.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: live animal cues require direct observation; an existing direct record form need not create a second transcription route.

assumptions: Shares are provisional and do not establish a measured baseline. Verify whether performance notes exist and how they are saved; where absent there is no invented documentation saving.

Trainer produces actual cue and response observations in s2, writes animal_id, performance_id, response, welfare concern and follow-up in s3, and checks them in s4 at full time. Record writing and save are separately represented rather than hidden in live cueing.

Zero applies where the current native form already provides a direct short note and save with no repeated copy/lookup. Native template/view/save options were considered; they do not remove actual observation or substantive writing. If duplicated entry is found, redesign that measured route rather than infer zero.
a1 binds the final checked note after s4. No new automation, external send or animal-facing device is added.
unknowns: Whether a note is actually required
research_questions: Does the existing performance-note route contain any actual duplicate entry beyond the direct native save?

incremental.description: No new system or maintenance is introduced

approvals.approved_version: s4 final performance observation note and animal reference

time_saved_range_pct.basis: All live cueing, separate writing/check and direct native save retain full time; no duplicate documentation action is established or new system added.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Observe animal condition and identify need for medical care.

steps.what: Observe the animals actual physical condition and behaviour
Judge whether observed changes require prompt veterinary attention
Write the observed signs, timing and relevant history for the veterinary contact
Approve the complete factual note, urgency and actual veterinary recipient
Send the approved factual contact note to the veterinary service
Discuss actual observations and immediate care needs with the veterinary professional
outputs: actual veterinary instructions and next actions

steps.what: Record and approve actual veterinary instructions, source and next actions
inputs: actual veterinary instructions and next actions

steps.what: Save the approved actual animal-care contact record

tasks.design: Keep actual animal observation, veterinary urgency judgement, factual contact writing and live consultation human. The existing {OPS_SYSTEM} care record and separate veterinary contact send retain full effort. Native forms already support both; splitting the record and send exposes no further change or saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Animal condition and urgency cannot be established from an automatically drafted summary.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing communication/record controls can transfer an already-complete approved factual note.
tasks.still_hard: Changes in condition and the veterinary conversation require direct attention.
tasks.human_edge: Notice the abnormal change and contact the right professional promptly.
tasks.altitude: Small communication-transfer savings; unchanged observation and medical-care escalation.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native communications and animal records can transfer approved factual notes without deciding diagnosis or treatment.

assumptions: Shares are provisional for cases using a written veterinary contact. Verify actual transfer actions; current automatic sends/saves earn no new benefit. Urgent direct telephone contact is not delayed for a form and its full labour remains human.

Trainer produces observed signs/time in s1; s3 captures animal_id, actual signs, onset, relevant history and contact reason at full time. s4 approves complete factual content and recipient before a1. No new machine input coding is needed.

Veterinary professional supplies actual advice in s6; s7 trainer separately records its source, instructions and next action before a2. Unknown advice is not prefilled. Physical care/vigilance and discussion are not reduced.
Native communication/record features precede code. Changed content needs new approval. If no separate written contact or manual save exists, those transfer savings do not apply.
research_questions: Is there a repeated manual transfer of an already-checked veterinary note that native controls can remove?

incremental.description: Check veterinary recipient and record field mappings

approvals.approved_version: s4 complete factual veterinary note and recipient

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Observation, actual signs and instructions capture, live veterinary discussion, existing send and save retain full effort; no new upkeep.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Evaluate animal temperament, abilities and training aptitude.

steps.what: Review existing animal history in a native chronological record view
Observe and interact with the animal under appropriate training situations
outputs: actual animal temperament and ability observations

steps.what: Judge temperament, abilities and suitable training boundaries from actual observations
inputs: actual animal temperament and ability observations

steps.what: Write the observed responses, interpretation, limitations and suggested training boundaries
inputs: actual animal temperament and ability observations

steps.what: Approve the complete animal aptitude evaluation record
Save the approved animal aptitude evaluation record

tasks.design: Configure a native chronological animal-history view in {OPS_SYSTEM} to reduce navigation, retaining history reading. Keep direct animal interaction, aptitude judgement and substantive evaluation writing full time. The completed final evaluation is approved before a separate save; no model scores temperament or decides an animals suitability.
tasks.previous_blocker: A history entry does not show how the animal responds in the current situation.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing dated records can be viewed together without re-entering their content.
tasks.still_hard: Context, welfare and changing behaviour require direct observation.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguish a situational response from a stable limit on training aptitude.
tasks.altitude: Less history navigation; unchanged animal evaluation.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: a native animal-record timeline can consolidate existing dated observations without evaluating temperament.

assumptions: Shares are provisional. Establish actual cross-screen history navigation; an existing timeline earns no new benefit. No animal evaluation or aptitude baseline is invented.

Existing care/training staff are the producers of dated animal_id, observation_time, author and note records under the current workflow; no new tagging or backfill is assumed. s1 retains 9 hours per provisional 100 for reading and resolving gaps. Missing chronology uses the current manual route.

Trainer produces actual responses in s2/s3; s4 captures context, observed response, interpretation, limits and training boundaries at full time. s5 approves the complete final record before a1; edits revoke approval. No new suitability classifier.
Native timeline/form options precede code; the proposed change does not reduce physical observation or imply external sharing.
research_questions: Can the current animal system show existing dated observations in one native view without extra staff coding?

incremental.description: Check timeline identity and date mappings

approvals.approved_version: s5 final animal aptitude evaluation and animal identifier

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional native history lookup saves six points minus 0.5 upkeep = 5.5; half eligibility gives 2.5. Actual animal interaction, judgement, writing and saving retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Keep records of animal health, diet and behaviour.

steps.what: Locate the correct animal and relevant previous entries in a native record view
inputs: existing animal identity and dated records

steps.what: Capture actual health observations, consumed diet and behaviour with source and time
inputs: actual animal observations and feeding records

steps.what: Check actual versus planned feeding, units, animal identity and unclear observations
Prepare the record using a native form with exact checked field transfer
outputs: candidate animal health diet and behaviour record

steps.what: Review and approve the complete final animal record and source references
inputs: candidate animal health diet and behaviour record

steps.what: Commit the approved final animal care record

tasks.design: Use a native animal-record view and supported exact-field import/form in {OPS_SYSTEM}. Keep original observation capture, ambiguous fact checking, substantive narrative and final review explicit. Reduce navigation and repeated transfer of already-checked facts; commit only the completed approved record. The form never converts a planned diet into actual consumption or interprets a symptom.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated transfer can lose the distinction between observed facts, plans and interpretations.
tasks.enabler_now: Native field mapping can carry exact checked observations into the correct animal record.
tasks.still_hard: Actual consumption and nuanced behaviour require observation and clear writing.
tasks.human_edge: Record uncertainty accurately rather than turn an impression into an unsupported health fact.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated record transfer with retained factual capture and final review.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native record forms can transfer exact checked source fields without inferring animal health or behaviour.

assumptions: Shares are provisional. Establish actual repeated entry and posting; if staff already write once into the final form, s4 transfer savings do not apply. Existing native views/imports earn no new benefit.

Trainer and existing feeding staff produce actual observations and feeding events. s2 trainer captures animal_id, observed_time, source_author, health_observation, offered_amount, consumed_amount, unit and behaviour in full time; s3 checks ambiguity and plans versus actuals. Missing consumed quantities remain unknown, not inferred from the feeding plan.

s4 maps only exact checked fields through an existing supported native import/form and retains 12 hours per provisional 100 for narrative and corrections. Unsupported imports use manual entry with no transfer benefit; no model medical interpretation.
s5 checks the complete final record before a1 binds its animal/time/version. Edits revoke approval. No external notification or care plan change is silently added; native features precede code.
research_questions: Are checked animal facts copied a second time, or does the current native form already capture them once?

incremental.description: Maintain exact field and unit mappings

approvals.approved_version: s5 complete actual animal care record and animal reference

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional native lookup and checked record fields save 12 points minus one upkeep = 11; partial eligible fields give three. Actual observation capture, verification, final checks and record commit retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Keep animal observation and judgement human while using precise records and controlled factual transfers.
reach: Help care colleagues distinguish actual observations, training judgements and veterinary instructions.
role.ambitious_version: A trainer who stays attentive to the animal and keeps a clear, current record of what was actually observed and advised.
